thread.title_full: Landry rebukes Cassidy on 'dangerous' COVID vaccine stance - NewsBreak

author: Emily Burleigh
title: Landry rebukes Cassidy on 'dangerous' COVID vaccine stance - NewsBreak
text:
By Emily Burleigh ,
8 hours ago Louisiana Jeff Landry has spoken out against U.S. Sen. Bill Cassidy’s comments on the importance of public access to COVID-19 vaccines. Cassidy, who is the chair of the Senate’s health committee, told reporters via phone press conference on Tuesday that ending vaccine mandates for children will lead to unnecessary deaths.
These comments follow Florida leaders Gov. Ron DeSantis and Surgeon General Dr. Joseph Ladapo plans to repeal all vaccine requirements for schoolchildren, as well as Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s proposal to introduce new restrictions for the COVID vaccine.
“That’s a bad decision,” Cassidy said in reference to DeSantis and Ladapo’s vaccine repeal announcement. “Within the year there will be children who are infected and children who die.”
He noted this is especially dangerous for immunocompromised children.
During the Tuesday press conference, Cassidy said the vaccine restrictions, in addition to endangering public health, also make it difficult for patients to be autonomous in their health care.
“What I read was a doctor saying that his patients who wanted the vaccine could not get the vaccine,” he said. “We’re inconveniencing the patient. We’re driving up costs for the patient. I’m a doctor. I want to make it as least expensive, as easy for the patient to get what the patient needs.”
He suggested that states could write a “blanket prescription” for COVID-19 vaccines, which would allow anyone to access the vaccine.
He further called the science on vaccine effectiveness “good and credible.”
Landry took to social media platform X, formerly Twitter, to speak out against Cassidy’s stance.
“The last time I checked you have a prescription pad, why don’t you just leave a prescription for the dangerous COVID shot at your district office and anyone can swing by and get one! I am sure big pharma would love you for that one!” he wrote.
In response, Cassidy replied on X stating, “True conservative should empower patients. Big government liberals make it harder for them to take action. Get big government out of a patient’s life.”
He also said on Tuesday that oversight actions regarding the Department of Health and Human Services will be “evident pretty soon” and that “radical transparency” is a must.
